params.prompt: Website hero screen, 16:9. Background: flat navy cloth #17233A with a very subtle woven texture. Centre: one large card with zig-zag pinked edges, hanging from a small black clip. The card shows image 2 on its front face; its right third is folded back to reveal image 1 on the underside, with a soft crease shadow. Under the card is a chalk-white #F1F1EA ticket in a condensed bold sans, all caps: "No. 12", "SOLD AS: DUSTY ROSE", "READS TO YOU AS: STONE". A hand-drawn yellow #F0E442 chalk circle surrounds "STONE", and a chalk triangle beside it carries the word "TRAP". Top-left wordmark "Said in Colour" in condensed chalk-white capitals. Small mono labels on the card faces: "front: you" and "underside: everyone else". Two smaller swatch cards hang at the edges, partly cropped. Flat lighting, no gold, no metallic, no gradients. Use the two supplied photos exactly as they are (image 1 = everyone else's view, the real photo; image 2 = the colour-blind man's view): do not alter the man's face, body or shirt; no extra people; no logos; no brand names; all text spelled exactly as given.
